name: manual_3630a4
claim: Review depth is not review diversity: N voices inside one orchestration correlate far more than their independence suggests, so treat in-harness cross-model agreement as weak evidence and get at least one cold, out-of-harness reviewer before calling a plan reviewed.

decisions.notes: On 2026-08-14 a gstack /autoplan run reviewed the Gemini skill-consolidation plan at full depth with two voices - an independent Claude pass and a real codex exec pass - across three phases, and reported high cross-model agreement as a confidence signal. An independent codex-reviewer session, running cold with its own framing, then found three more findings of equal or greater severity including a data-loss path. The agreement was partly an artifact of shared harness, shared framing, and a shared reading of the plan.
